request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 in Tunis lost all service for a few hours yesterday evening. What happened? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after this time does

response.text: The evidence from anomalies (T1), topology (T2, T3), alarms (T4), changes (T5), and maintenance (T6) confirms that sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 suffered a complete service outage from 18:00 to 22:00 on 2026-09-02 due to a transport failure (LINK_LOS on shared fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A at 18:00, which cleared at 22:00). No configuration changes or maintenance windows were active during this time, pointing clearly to an unplanned transport link disruption.
